instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Nova Technologies is a specialized generic drug manufacturer focusing on oral solid dosage forms, adhering strictly to stringent EU GMP standards for quality control and batch consistency. The company operates within highly regulated markets requiring meticulous documentation and rapid response to regulatory changes like label updates or facility audits.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next 2 years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows. We are not looking to grow headcount — we want to do more with our existing team.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance for Manufacturing Equipment
opportunities.rationale: Implementing machine learning models to predict equipment failure in the continuous manufacturing line can drastically reduce unplanned downtime and associated waste, directly impacting operational efficiency. This leverages existing digital maturity by transitioning from reactive maintenance to proactive scheduling.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on sensor integration costs for key production assets.
Pilot the model on one high-failure component using existing telemetry data.
Conduct GDPR and data privacy compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in unplanned maintenance downtime by 20% within Q3.
milestones: Q3: Pilot deployment and ROI validation

opportunities.title: End-to-End Automated Compliance Workflow (Regulatory Tech)
opportunities.rationale: Given the high regulatory environment, radical investment in a centralized RegTech platform could automate documentation generation and submission tracking, drastically reducing manual compliance overhead. This is a structural change that addresses process barriers at its core.

first_actions: Identify critical bottlenecks in batch record completion and deviation reporting.
Explore SaaS RegTech solutions specifically targeting pharmaceutical quality systems.
Conduct GDPR and data privacy compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Software licensing for a centralized workflow tool ($50k - $150k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time spent on manual documentation review by 40%.
milestones: Q3: Vendor selection and PoC (Proof of Concept)
Q4: Full implementation across key therapeutic lines

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional efficiency task force focused on identifying the top three manual bottlenecks in order processing and logistics.
Initiate the formal vendor evaluation process for RegTech solutions to assess potential radical workflow automation opportunities.

key_weaknesses: Process rigidity resulting from legacy systems and recent organizational merger integration.
High dependency on specialized 'talent' in both development and regulatory compliance, leading to scalability constraints.
Severe time scarcity for innovation due to operational demands and lack of formally ring-fenced innovation budget.
